--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT RETR_KEY, MESSAGE_TYPE, TRAN_END_TIME, AUTH_NBR, CARD_NBR, INTERNAL_RESP_CODE, 
    BANKNET_REF_NBR, RECV_ID, COUNT(1) CNT 
FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXTXLGP
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY RETR_KEY, MESSAGE_TYPE, TRAN_END_TIME, AUTH_NBR, CARD_NBR, INTERNAL_RESP_CODE, BANKNET_REF_NBR, RECV_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1;


--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() 
    OVER(PARTITION BY RETR_KEY, MESSAGE_TYPE, TRAN_END_TIME, AUTH_NBR, CARD_NBR, INTERNAL_RESP_CODE, BANKNET_REF_NBR, RECV_ID 
        ORDER BY RETR_KEY) RN , *
INTO BUSC.CCD_CBCEXTXLGP_WITH_DUP_20240402
FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXTXLGP;

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN 
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXTXLGP;

--4 CHECK COUNT DUP TABLE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXTXLGP_WITH_DUP_20240402;
